added_reason: OD-20 H1: configurable rolling discovery horizon. Research (art_h1eHBvZp) found a six-month window yielded ~15% more gate-reaching leads than 12 months under Keenable's 25-result cap, so the prior decade-wide planner string is replaced by a 183-day window with dates computed at run time.

objectives.origin: The original public announcement or statement in which the named San Francisco person or agency made this commitment, ideally an official or first-party source.
objectives.delivery: An official or reputable source reporting whether this specific San Francisco commitment was delivered, completed or opened, and when.
objectives.survival: A recent official or reputable source on the current status of this specific San Francisco project or program.
